entries.what: Azure OpenAI's Assistants API sunset on 2026-08-26. The classic how-to page calls it retired. Neither page says what a request gets, so a failing call isn't proven.
lookFor: A read or call of .assistants or .threads on beta, on a client in an Azure OpenAI repo
A request to /openai/assistants or /openai/threads
The header value assistants=v2 in code that talks to Azure OpenAI
entries.replacement: The Responses API, through the Microsoft Foundry Agents service.
requires: Threads become Conversations, which store items rather than only messages.
Runs become Responses, with no polling loop.
Assistants become Agent Versions, created with create_version() and a PromptAgentDefinition.
The Responses API and Foundry Agent Service are not in every Azure region: check that yours supports them.
